title: Invertible modules descend along affine transition limits
statement: Let $I$ be a small nonempty directed set, $(Z_i)_{i\in I}$ an inverse system of quasi-compact schemes [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] that are quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], with affine transition morphisms $q_{ji}:Z_j\to Z_i$ for $j\geq i$ [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Let $Z=\varprojlim_i Z_i$ with projections $q_i:Z\to Z_i$ be its limit in the category of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Here being a limit means $q_{ji}\circ q_j=q_i$ for $j\geq i$, and for every scheme $T$ and family $t_i:T\to Z_i$ satisfying $q_{ji}\circ t_j=t_i$ there is a unique morphism $t:T\to Z$ with $q_i\circ t=t_i$ for every $i$. For every invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module $L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], there exist $i\in I$ and an invertible $\mathcal O_{Z_i}$-module $L_i$ such that $q_i^*L_i\cong L$, where $q_i^*$ is the tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback].

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-invertible-fp-tensor-models] to $L$. Obtain $i,A_i,B_i,a,b$ and $P_i=A_i\otimes B_i$, with $P_i$ and $\mathcal O_{Z_i}$ finitely presented, and the isomorphism $\epsilon:q_i^*P_i\cong\mathcal O_Z$ given by the tensor comparison, $a\otimes b$, and evaluation. The small nonempty directed set, qcqs stages, affine transitions and scheme limit are exactly those assumed here.

source.place: Tag 0B8W, lemma-descend-invertible-modules, proof of (2), tensor-inverse argument.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf] to $q_i$ to obtain $q_i^*\mathcal O_{Z_i}\cong\mathcal O_Z$. Compose the tensor evaluation isomorphism from step 1 with the inverse of this isomorphism. Apply [lem-trf-fp-module-limit-isomorphism-descent] to the finitely presented modules $A_i\otimes B_i$ and $\mathcal O_{Z_i}$. It gives $k\ge i$ and mutually inverse finite-stage maps $f,g$. Form their isomorphism and compose with the structure-sheaf pullback isomorphism for $q_{ki}$.

source.place: Tag 0B8W, lemma-descend-invertible-modules, proof of (2), tensor-inverse argument.

proof.text: Set $A_k=q_{ki}^*A_i$ and $B_k=q_{ki}^*B_i$. The inverse comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor], followed by the isomorphism from step 2, gives $A_k\otimes B_k\cong\mathcal O_{Z_k}$. Both factors are finitely presented by [lem-pc-tensor-pullback-finite-presentation], hence quasi-coherent. Verify the tensor-inverse characterization in [def-sc-invertible-module] in the local-rank-one Lean API by a proved private helper: on each affine open $U$, [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-tensor-product-affine-sections] identifies sections of the tensor with the tensor of sections. The resulting tensor isomorphism with $\mathcal O(U)$ makes both section modules invertible by Mathlib Module.Invertible.left and right, hence finite projective. Their ranks at each prime multiply to one by Mathlib Module.rankAtStalk_tensorProduct and rankAtStalk_self, so each rank is one. The proved source criterion isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_isAffineOpen gives local freeness of rank one, and IsInvertible.of_sheafOfModules gives invertibility. Finally [def-trf-affine-limit-tensor-pullback-comparison] followed by $a$ identifies $q_k^*A_k$ with $L$. Return $k,A_k$.
